name: critic-calibrate
context_rationale: The skill itself orchestrates from the main agent but all heavy analysis is delegated to a fresh-context 'critic-calibrate' subagent; the skill only collects and presents inputs and logs results, which does not depend on the main thread's current slice state.
summary: Cross-slice meta-skill that mines 'Missed by Critic' and 'Critic calibration' entries from the last N (default 15) archived reflections to identify blind-spot patterns in the Critic prompt. Spawns a 'critic-calibrate' subagent that classifies patterns, applies a >=3-distinct-slices threshold, and produces 0-3 evidence-backed proposals. Proposals are presented one-at-a-time to the user for accept/modify/reject; this skill never auto-applies edits to the Critic agent prompt. Logs every run to critic-calibration-log.json for longitudinal effectiveness tracking.

reads.purpose: Enumerate last N archived slice folders for reflection window
Extract Critic calibration + Missed by Critic sections for pattern analysis
Optional quick navigation to archived slices

outputs.purpose: Audit trail of calibration runs: pattern summary, proposals, user decisions, effectiveness checks

agents.name: critic-calibrate
agents.when: Step 2, after gathering archived reflections, current Critic prompt, and calibration log
agents.purpose: Classifies Critic miss patterns, applies evidence threshold, and generates 0-3 targeted prompt-update proposals for critique.md

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Read archived reflection.json files (Critic calibration sections), ~/.claude/agents/critique.json, critic-calibration-log.json

harness_tools.name: AskUserQuestion
harness_tools.purpose: Present each proposal one-at-a-time for user accept/modify/reject decision
